Product & interaction design · 2026

REM.log

A place for the things you almost remember.

A guided space for capturing dreams in fragments, images, and connections. Built at CreateSC 2026, where the project won first place in the Figma Make track.

Role
UI/UX Designer & Interaction Designer
Tools
Figma Make, Claude
Team
Tina Jiang, Iris Xu, Psychea Dai
Platform
Web / Figma Make

Start with a fragment.

Dreams rarely arrive as orderly narratives. REM.log begins with keyword fragments and generates a visual alongside the written entry, preserving the visual, irrational quality of what the user remembers.

A map of an inner landscape.

As entries accumulate, a Dream Map connects recurring symbols, places, and moods. I worked on the interface and interaction design with Iris Xu and Psychea Dai, using Figma Make and Claude to bring the experience into a working web prototype.

CreateSC 2026.

REM.log received first place in the Figma Make track. The prototype explores a gentler way to record personal experiences, allowing fragments to remain fragments while giving them a place to return to.
